name: Joushima Shiori
source:
One of the instructors in charge of the main character. A refreshing and serious young woman ... not a decent woman.
She is called Ms. Brilliant. The body is slender and boyish. She suffers from A-cup angst due to her small chest. She does karate and has considerable skill. The trainees also mercilessly hit the right fist. She likes dogs and monkeys.

[From Getchu]
